description: This file defines a Java interface named WithManifest, which specifies a contract for classes that have an associated manifest string. It includes a single method getManifest() that returns the manifest type hint and is annotated to indicate it should not return null.

classes.name: WithManifest
classes.description: An interface for classes that have a manifest string available, providing a method to retrieve this string.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns the manifest (type hint) as a non-null String.
